title: 第1章 师尊我有个不情之请第2章 系统激活
slug: 修真废柴我的系统有点猛
lines: 苍云世界，霸夏皇朝西南。
绵延数万公里的白云山脉如一头巨兽匍匐在地。
在山峰最高处，灵气如雾，终年缭绕不散。
奇峰险壑间流泉飞瀑似银练垂落，珍禽异兽偶见踪迹；
腾挪于云端之中，恍如一方遗世独立的仙家画卷。
而阴阳宗，便如一座仙家洞府，镶嵌在这片绵延巨山的深处。
阴阳宗十二主峰之一的落霞峰，峰如其名常年沐浴在霞光之中。
而此刻落霞殿内却一片清冷，霞光透过巨大的雕花窗口。
在光洁如玉般的地面上投下斑驳的影子。
空气中弥漫着千里灵檀的特殊幽香，沁人心脾。
而那高高的白月阶之上，一张由千年温玉雕刻而成的宽大宝座上。
一道倩影端坐在其中，正是当代落霞峰峰主——冷月葵。
她身着一袭素白无纹的广袖道袍，衣料轻薄如云似雾，非但未能遮掩。
反倒隐隐勾勒出内里惊心动魄的饱满曲线；
如瀑般的青丝，仅用一根简单的白玉簪松松挽起，几缕发丝慵懒地垂落。
肌肤却比那凝结的万年寒玉更胜三分莹白剔透。
五官精致，唇瓣不点而朱。
这绝色容颜之下，目光却落在殿心那个微微佝偻的身影上。
带着一丝难以言喻的复杂。
姚德龙——岁月在他身上刻下了毫不留情的印记，
佝偻的脊背，须发尽染白霜，深深浅浅的沟壑爬满了曾经或许还算得上俊俏的脸庞。
唯有一双眼睛，浑浊的眼底深处。
偶尔闪过一丝与这衰朽皮囊格格不入的、属于另一个世界灵魂的狡黠与不甘。
八十年前……冷月葵眸底掠过一丝极淡的、几不可察的涟漪。
那时她还只是宗门内一个天赋颇高的普通弟子。
一次下山执行任务的途中，途经一个偏僻的凡人小镇。
却被一个蓬头垢面的七岁稚童摊位上的“话本”
所吸引——
《水浒英雄传》、《西游取经记》……
那些光怪陆离的故事，那些鲜活跳脱的人物，那些闻所未闻的奇思妙语。
深深吸引了她那长期修炼而枯燥的心。
这小童，便是姚德龙。
她惊叹此小子“早慧”
，认定他神魂特异，必有大才。
content_en:
Cangyun World, southwest of Baxia Dynasty.
The Baiyun Mountains, stretching for tens of thousands of kilometers, crawl on the ground like a giant beast.
At the highest point of the mountain, the aura lingers like mist all year round.
Among the strange peaks and dangerous ravines, there are flowing springs and waterfalls like falling silver, and rare birds and animals are occasionally seen;
Moving among the clouds, it looks like an independent fairy scroll.
The Yin Yang Sect is like a fairy cave, embedded in the depths of this huge mountain.
Luoxia Peak, one of the twelve main peaks of the Yin Yang Sect, is bathed in the glow of the sun all year round as its name suggests.
But at this moment, the Luoxia Hall was deserted, and the rays of sunlight filtered through the huge carved window.
Casting mottled shadows on the smooth, jade-like ground.
The air is filled with the special fragrance of Qianli Lingtan, which is refreshing.
And on the high white moon steps, there is a large throne carved from thousand-year-old warm jade.
A beautiful figure sits among them, it is the contemporary master of Luoxia Peak - Leng Yuekui.
She was wearing a plain white robe with wide sleeves and no lines. The material was as thin as clouds and mist, but it failed to cover up her appearance.
On the contrary, it faintly outlines the thrilling and full curves inside;
The waterfall-like green hair is loosely held up with only a simple white jade hairpin, and a few strands of hair hang down lazily.
The skin is even more crystal clear than the condensed ten thousand year cold jade.
The facial features are exquisite, and the lips are not dotted but are red.
Under this stunning appearance, his eyes fell on the slightly stooped figure in the center of the palace.
With a hint of indescribable complexity.
Yao Delong - Time has left a merciless mark on him,
His stooped back, beard and hair were stained with white frost, and deep and shallow ravines covered his face that might once have been considered handsome.
There is only a pair of eyes, deep in the cloudy eyes.
Occasionally, there is a flash of cunning and unwillingness belonging to the soul of another world that is incompatible with this decaying skin.
Eighty years ago... A faint, almost imperceptible ripple flashed across Leng Yuekui's eyes.
At that time, she was just an ordinary disciple with high talent within the sect.
On his way down the mountain to perform a mission, he passed by a remote mortal town.
But the "storybook" written by an unkempt seven-year-old child at the stall
Attracted——
"Water Margin", "Journey to the West for Buddhist Scriptures"...
Those bizarre stories, those vivid characters, those unheard of whimsical sayings.
It deeply attracted her long-term cultivation and boring heart.
This kid is Yao Delong.
She marveled at this boy's "precocious wisdom"
, determined that he had a special soul and must be a great talent.
